text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower was desperate to visit a<n>shrine, so
here we are.

text_block_list.text: Thank you for doing this for me, Big<n>Brother.

text_block_list.text: Well, I want to go lots of places with<n>you...

text_block_list.text:

luck.

text_block_list.text: But, as we're praying...

text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Part of the old roof falls off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, it's just like I thought.
choice_data_list: Good thing it didn't hit us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if I wasn't here, this definitely<n>wouldn't have
happened...

text_block_list.text: I should've known. I'm just—
choice_data_list: We're safe thanks to your prayer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My prayer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying... that wasn't bad<n>luck just now...
but good luck?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-that would mean... the gods were<n>listening?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It must be because you prayed with<n>me... It feels
like a weight has been<n>lifted from me!

text_block_list.text:
Her prayers answered, Rice Shower<n>beams with
joy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Part of the old roof falls off.
Oh no... This is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The moment I try to run after her, I<n>stumble over a
gutter in the stone<n>path.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother! Are you okay? I'm<n>sorry... This is all
my fault.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister! Are you okay? I'm sorry...<n>This is all my
fault.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I try to<n>reassure her,
she won't stop beating<n>herself up about what
happened.
